newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - TriTeal cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - TriTeal cut to hold.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist cut its rating on shares of TriTeal Corp to hold from buy after the company said it expected to post disappointing March quarter results, missing the investment firm's revenue estimate by a range of $2.3 million to $2.6 million.
-- It said it was lowering the rating "until we gain confidence in the company's ability to better forecast its quarterly business going forward."
-- In a statement, Hambrecht & Quist said its disappointing results in its fiscal fourth quarter ended March 31 stemmed from the company's inability to close contracts with one of its resellers.
-- TriTeal produces system software and integrated applications that enable multiplatform deployment of client/server applications.
-- Its shares were 7/8 higher at 7-1/2 early Thursday afternoon.
